notes.title: Steam Achievements Update
notes.content: [p]The battle for survival in Tortuga City just got tougher. This update brings over 30 new achievements tailored to your strategy, resource management, and wave defense skills. Only the sharpest minds will unlock them all. Are you up for the challenge?[/p]

notes.title: Steam Achievements Update + Resolution Update
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] 30+ Steam Achievements added
[*] Resolution Option added
[/list]

Unlock 30+ new achievements tied to wave survival, building efficiency, and special in-game events.
Whether you're a perfectionist or a hardcore strategist — there's something new to conquer!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.13
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]

• Mini Map Added:
A small mini map now appears at the top of the screen, showing the player’s current position relative to the main base. This helps players better estimate their distance from the base.
Additionally, the outermost walls of the base are now displayed on the map for easier orientation.

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]

  • The sniper on his tower now accurately hits targets again.
  • Snipers inside the shuttle are now more precise.
  • The Molotov cocktail now deals proper damage over time again.
  • The number of gym visitors has increased, but each visitor generates slightly less money.
    (This change is intended to make the building appear more active and visually engaging.)
  • Endgame volume has been adjusted for a better experience.
  • The sniper no longer respawns automatically after loading a save.
  • The medical shuttle siren now functions correctly.
  • The mini-game pop-up in the club has been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.012
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A hint now points out the factory, as it is too important and was overlooked by some players.
[*] When Shadow Shells is talking to you, the game can no longer be paused to prevent subtitle errors.
[/list]
